what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Cameroon in Canada: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3749 Cameroonian asylum seekers in Canada, 9.9% of all asylum seekers from Cameroon.
Refugees from Cameroon, a separate group, live mostly in Nigeria, Chad, the United States and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Ambazonia territory in Cameroon in every year from 2017 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Cameroon with JAS, and with the Islamic State group, in some years from 2015.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 87 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Canada only.
